version_recommendation.default: Keep the requested b543e8b full directories for reproducible restoration; they are complete and unchanged. Treat current upstream fixes as documented limitations or an explicit later upgrade, rather than silently moving versions.
downloader_base_limitations: saveFullTextResponse can overwrite a different paper with the same sanitized title; isolate outputs by original record ID/source attempt. HEAD adds content-SHA-aware unique filenames.
Any nonempty Crossref licence string can count as OA in base; do not treat the downloader OA label as proof of an open licence. HEAD only accepts Creative Commons/open licence patterns.
academic_base_limitations: Missing future annotations in arxiv module can trigger an import/type-evaluation error on some Python versions; HEAD adds from __future__ import annotations.

HEAD fixes PubMed mixed-markup title truncation, Crossref unavailable citation status, empty/error result handling for arXiv/Scopus, citation defaults, MEDLINE author format, converter urlopen import, and --retry 0 behaviour. None requires a new topical literature search.
shared_changes: HEAD improves whole-manuscript number matching and distinguishes millimolar mM from length mm. No direct impact on full-text restoration.

supporting_information.bare_doi_si: Successful OA/publisher API main text is followed by attachSupportingInformation -> ensureBrowser -> downloadSiForDoi -> CDP navigation and DOM scan. A missing CDP yields si.fetch_failed while preserving main-text success.
supporting_information.direct_url_si: Non-CNKI --pdf-url uses HTTP fetch without CDP and unconditionally sets SI not_found with reason that the PDF URL does not identify an SI landing page. It does not inspect the publisher landing page or attachments; this is unassessed, not evidence of absence.
supporting_information.browserless_si_capability: Bundled production SI scanning/fetch defaults use CDP; no native HTTP landing-page SI workflow is implemented. selectSupportingInformationLinks is pure and can classify independently collected links, but scanPage and fetchAnyToFile use browser context.
supporting_information.file_types: WoS clean-bundle selector covers PDF/ZIP/Word/Excel/CSV/TSV/TXT/audio/video and preserves attachment filenames/MIME extensions. Ordinary DOI downloadSi uses generic browser fetchAnyToFile, not a PDF-only saver.
coverage_limitations: WoS clean-bundle helper only used when topic + exact title + SI flags are present; ordinary DOI SI path uses a simpler URL regex.
WoS helper excludes external GitHub/Zenodo/Figshare/Dryad/OSF repositories; those legitimate attachments need a separate authorised source workflow.
No browserless SI absence claim should be made from direct URL si.not_found.

old_node_proxy_record.observed_historical_instruction: Node 24.19 with NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1, not a source patch in the saved method records.
old_node_proxy_record.interpretation: NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY controls current Node global HTTP(S) fetch proxy use; it does not create the separate localhost web-access CDP service. --proxy points at that CDP service, not the outbound HTTP(S) network proxy.
old_node_proxy_record.migration: Use only current injected proxy variables and preserve local bypass/NO_PROXY and TLS verification. Check Node version supports the flag before enabling it. Do not copy old proxy URLs, temporary paths, virtualenvs or assume CDP is available.
old_node_proxy_record.network_validation: Not performed in this static subtask; parent runtime tests determine whether the flag is currently necessary.
